inputs.default: Add silent VS Code tasks for git, GPU check and panel restart`n`nCo-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>

tasks.label: restart-panel
tasks.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name like 'python%'" | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'webapp' } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force }; Start-Process pythonw -ArgumentList 'webapp.py','--host','0.0.0.0','--port','8800' -WorkingDirectory '${workspaceFolder}' -WindowStyle Hidden; Start-Sleep 3; (Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:8800/ -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 10).StatusCode 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath logs\restart-panel.log

tasks.label: gpu-check
tasks.command: nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,memory.used --format=csv,noheader 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath logs\gpu-check.log; nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,process_name,used_memory --format=csv,noheader 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath logs\gpu-check.log -Append

tasks.label: git-sync-main
tasks.command: git fetch origin 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath logs\git.log; git --no-pager merge origin/main --no-edit 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath logs\git.log -Append; git status -sb 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath logs\git.log -Append; git --no-pager log --oneline -3 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath logs\git.log -Append

tasks.label: git-push
tasks.command: git push origin HEAD 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath logs\git.log; git status -sb 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath logs\git.log -Append

tasks.label: git-commit-all
tasks.command: git add -A; git commit -m "${input:commitMessage}" 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath logs\git.log; git --no-pager log --oneline -1 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath logs\git.log -Append

tasks.label: relevant-panel-tests
tasks.command: python -m unittest tests.test_panel tests.test_finished -k page_script -k test_skip_starts -k test_stop_kills -k queueing_a_pending -k pending_jobs_arrow -k output_order -k gpu_heat_guard -k afterburner -k FinishedTest -k AimdoRetryTest -k WorkPrivacyTest -k nsfw_tags -k private_mode_tags 2>&1 | Tee-Object -FilePath logs\panel-tests.log; exit $LASTEXITCODE
